evidence: Labeled 'Block storage' and modifies src/node/blockstorage.cpp and src/validation.cpp to manage blockfile ranges and assumeutxo snapshot base block tracking.
rationale: Fixes an assertion crash during background validation and startup failures that falsely report database corruption. As described in the PR, storing the snapshot base block before snapshot activation causes an abort in WriteBlockUndo (`Assertion m_blockfile_cursors[type] failed`) or a VerifyDB startup error forcing an unnecessary reindex.
